finalMessage:
All three bugs are fixed and merged into `main`, and the final ship check passed. I re-ran `npm test` myself: 19 of 19 pass. Nothing was pushed.

**Your options were ignored.** I passed the arguments to the workflow encoded as JSON twice, so it read the whole thing as the task text. The run used the defaults instead of your settings:
- **Build:** Sonnet, not Haiku.
- **Refute:** all three reviewer types (correctness, edges-and-regressions and verification) at default effort, not your two at medium.
- **Final check:** Fable, not Opus.

The fixes themselves are not affected, because the task text still reached the planner intact. The run cost about $2.20, more than your cheaper setup would have.

| Bug | Fix | Regression test |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Discount one cent low | `src/money.js` now rounds half up; $10.01 at 15% off gives $8.51 | `test/money.test.js` gets 850 instead of 851 on the old code |
| 2. CSV breaks on commas, quotes and line breaks | `src/csv.js` quotes fields per RFC 4180 and keeps `\n` line endings | `test/csv.test.js` fails on the old code |
| 3. 500 for a key with no usage | `src/server.js` returns 404 `{"error":"not_found"}` for both JSON and CSV | `test/server.test.js` gets 500 instead of 404 on the old code |

Each test was run against the old code and failed there. Requests against the running server returned the correctly quoted row for the key `team, alpha`, and a 404 for an unknown key in both formats. The whole change is 6 files, +33/−3, with each fix touching only its own source file and test file.

Two non-blocking notes from review:
- **The new 404 test doesn't close the server if it fails.** If that bug comes back, the test run hangs until it times out instead of reporting a clear failure. The existing tests are written the same way. Wrapping the assertions in `try/finally` would fix it.
- **Fractional discount percents can still round wrong.** For example, 64.4% off 125 cents gives 44 instead of 45, because of floating-point error. Your rule and the bug report only cover whole-number percents, so this is outside the scope here. Scaling percents to whole numbers, or rejecting fractional ones, would fix it.

The temporary build copies of the repo are still in the untracked `.claude/` directory.
